verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a per-request opt-out from its Model Improvement Program (mip_opt_out=true), which stops that request's data from being retained, directly addressing usage-data retention opt-out. However, this is narrowly scoped to MIP/model-training data and is per-request rather than an account-wide telemetry/usage-tracking toggle; there's no evidence of opting out of operational telemetry, analytics, or general usage tracking. Missing for 10: account-level or global telemetry opt-out settings, clarity on what non-MIP telemetry is collected and whether it can be disabled, independent confirmation of opt-out efficacy.
